introHtml: Blue bistro mugs bring a calm, professional look to any breakroom or café. Whether you choose a deep navy or a vibrant cobalt, these mugs stand out on the shelf or in a gift set. The 12 oz Concord Mug and 15 oz Basecamp® Zion Mug are popular options that pair well with custom logos. Screen printing or debossing keeps your brand visible through hundreds of dishwasher cycles. For marketing directors and HR managers, blue mugs convey trust and reliability—perfect for employee gifts or client appreciation.
